[quote=montfleur;61543837][b]March 26, 2028: Wars Abounding[/b]

Elseyr is in on fire, in ways we havent seen in nearly half a century, began the duchess Eleonore De Lorraine as she moved to sit before the king of Montfleur, Henri XVII.

Henri frowned, Yes, I have received concerning reports from Rosenmarkke, and their allies, he replied, But what is our risk of being dragged in? he asked.

Negligible, replied the duchess, The Council of Ministries and the Senate would block any attempt for us to get moved into a war, the one time that the left is actually useful, she laughed.

Henri gave a slight smirk, A blessing to that, he replied with a nod.

Now, there has been concern, your majesty, that the war in Rosenmarkke will cause a refugee crisis into Montfleur, minister De la Roche brought that up in our last meeting, continued the duchess.

...I assume, the minister, the minister spoke in humanitarian terms? asked Henri.

Yes, I believe he said that failure to admit at least some refugees would make Montfleur as guilty as Wuloosya, replied the duchess.

And it was Wuloosya that started this war? asked Henri.

Correct, and also who dragged in the EDU, 

Henri frowned, Elseyr is really on fire, he muttered, D-mn liberalist institutionshas the International Forum made comment yet? 

No, and I am sure you know why, replied the duchess.

The EDU has them in a stranglehold replied Henri.

Correct, 

Henri sighed, What are our military options, he asked.

Limited, replied the duchess.
We will then remain neutral in this, we arent a part of the EDU or THEP and their squabbles, Montfleur must remain independent, Henri declared resolutely.

Indeed, anyways, I believe that is all I have for you today sir, replied the duchess.

Very good, thank you for your help in this matter, replied Henri. [/quote]

[i][u][b]The Technocracy Revolution[/b][/u]

The days following the asset freeze in Lavian were marked by diplomatic tensions in the region, but the political situation in Oceanica was changing more quickly than most people realized. On the surface, everything seemed to be going normally in the country. The big businesses were still running like normal, and the leaders in the country were assuring the people that Oceanica was still dedicated to democracy.

However, in a secret meeting in a heavily secured area beneath the Enclave Pentagon, the real situation in Oceanica was being decided by some of the most powerful people in the countrys politics and tech industry, along with top level officials in the countrys government and the strategic directors of the secret Enclave Organization.

There was a large digital screen in the middle of the table, which showed economic trends, tech development charts, and strategic maps of the world situation. Seated at the head of the table was the Enclave Director.

For decades, he said, Oceanica has been using traditional democratic principles to guide its way forward. He waved his hand in dismissal. The world we are living in today is not run by these old systems anymore.

He pointed to the digital screen in front of him. Economic warfare, tech development, supply chain management, and development of artificial intelligence are the real systems that will further govern the world today.

Next to speak was the top tech executive in the group. The Lavian asset freeze was the final proof of something we have been saying for years, the world of politics is changing more slowly than the world of tech.
The Director nodded.

If Oceanica is going to stay the most advanced and safest country, we must change how we make decisions.

Another official leaned forward a bit.

You want to start now?

The Director paused, then said, Yes.

Around the room, a few people softly agreed. Mark the beginning of a long and gradual shift in how things were structured.

Secret memos were sent out that evening to all important government offices, big companies, and research groups throughout the country. Key programs would be expanded. Advisory technology councils would be given greater say in how the country would be run. Companies and research groups would be working with decision-makers in the government.
Nothing would be different on the surface.

Oceanica would continue to be a democratic republic. Elections would continue to be held. Parties would continue to vie for power. But increasingly, it would be technology experts, research groups, and corporate leaders working with the Enclave to determine how the country should be run.[/i]
